model: Inherited session configuration; exact resolved model identifier, reasoning effort, token usage, and cost not captured.
method: Explicit skill invocation in a fresh evaluator context, followed by three requests in the same context. Only raw inputs and the candidate skill were supplied; expected outcomes and review conclusions were withheld.
tool_access: Host tools available; evaluator instructed to use only temporary inputs and skill, preserve them, and write the requested response files. Cross-workspace read isolation was not enforced.

acceptance_review.retry: Passed parent review: explains the retry limit, delay, final error and failed-attempt history; consistently distinguishes Delivery and Attempt; qualifies local evidence and omits unsupported performance/reliability praise.
acceptance_review.settings: Passed parent review: one compact paragraph retains label change, same handler, observed save, and unverified keyboard behavior.
acceptance_review.table: Passed parent review: requested comparison table preserves facts and verification limit.
acceptance_review.json: Passed parent review and JSON parsing: exact requested key set; supplied local successes distinguished from unverified production and performance claims.

limits: No baseline comparison or repeated sampling; these responses do not establish a measured improvement or general reliability.
Host instructions also guide communication, so outcomes cannot be attributed solely to this skill.
No automatic-selection or desktop reload test.
The retry and browser observations were synthetic input records; no webhook runtime or browser was exercised by the evaluator.
